input.query: My camera photos come out blurry
input.siis_response: Blurry photos are usually caused by a dirty lens, camera shake or focus problems. Clean the camera lens with a soft microfiber cloth. Remove any case or lens protector that covers the camera. Tap the subject on the preview screen to focus before taking the picture. Open Camera > Camera settings > Scene optimizer and turn it on. Open Camera > Camera settings > Reset settings and tap Reset if photos are still blurry.
